section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses conducted on a single study with samples from three countries (Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden), including both boys and girls (N=1012 total: 79 Danish girls, 50 Danish boys, 296 Portuguese girls, 217 Portuguese boys, 155 Swedish girls, 215 Swedish boys). The analyses included confirmatory factor analyses to test the BAS-2 construct validity, multi-group CFAs to test invariance across sex and country, internal consistency reliability assessment, and convergent validity testing using bivariate correlations between BAS-2 and other measures including BMI.
